Re-reviewed 2026-11-22: latest moved to 158.0.8127-98 at 02:42Z, then back to 160.0.8177-0 at 05:12Z. Upstream README says every Chrome release build is tagged latest, published by chrome-devtools-npm through the Chrome for Testing pipeline, so latest moves between the stable, beta and canary lines. These builds have no npm provenance attestation; the last semver release, 17.0.2, had one from GitHub Actions. This matches the documented move of the source to Chromium, not a compromise. The 158.0.8127-98 tarball matched its dist.integrity and had no install lifecycle scripts. Its dependencies are zod ^4.6.5 and mitt, and it has no exports map. Its code is in out/Default/gen/src with no lib/cjs, and no new network or exec patterns relative to 12.1.0. The 158 line is deferred for the same Playwright lib/cjs import incompatibility. Re-check when a latest appears on a 161+ line, when the publisher changes from chrome-devtools-npm, when provenance appears or disappears, or when Playwright supports the new layout.
